title: Flavored Rice and Pasta Mixture, Reduced Sodium

content.title: About
content.content: The flavored rice and pasta mixture is a ready‑to‑cook blend that combines premium polished rice, small durum‑wheat pasta, and a blend of natural herbs and spices. The reduced‑sodium version contains 384 mg of sodium per serving, making it suitable for low‑salt diets.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend pairs two staple carbohydrate sources—rice and pasta—for lasting satiety.
Reduced sodium is achieved by using herbs and spices instead of added salt.
Preparation is simple: add hot water and let stand for 5‑7 minutes.
It uses whole‑grain rice rather than refined starch.
Suitable for vegetarians and, when gluten‑free pasta is used, for gluten‑free diets.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Complex carbohydrates provide a quick, sustained source of energy for active individuals.

items.title: Low sodium
items.content: 384 mg of sodium per serving helps maintain normal blood pressure.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Rice and whole‑grain pasta contain thiamine, niacin, and vitamin B6, supporting metabolism.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain pasta and rice bran add fiber that promotes healthy digestion.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: The blend provides magnesium and phosphorus, important for bones and muscles.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: If regular pasta is used, the product may trigger reactions in people with wheat or gluten intolerance.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: The mixture can raise blood sugar quickly, so portion control is advised for diabetics.

items.title: Possible gluten cross‑contamination
items.content: Manufacturing facilities may have trace gluten, which is relevant for those with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour 250 ml of boiling water over the mix, stir, and let stand for 5‑7 minutes. Add vegetables, chicken breast, or legumes to boost protein. Finish with fresh herbs or a drizzle of olive oil if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. Follow the shelf‑life date on the label. Once opened, consume within 3‑4 weeks.
